title: Heads Built from Boxes
voice: Unsigned gallery voice; curation/voice/style-guide.md as amended 2026-10-16 (Feeling and message)
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Rewrite for feeling and message after the collector approved the pilot room (Skulls and Shadows) on 2026-10-16. Every work was inspected again from the published WebP at 1200 px in room order and as one wall. Facts come from data/gallery.json and curation/analysis/strokes/measures.json; readings rest on the pictures, the record and the artist's sourced words. scope: The owned subset: the 27 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: A head drawn as a box, and the box is grinning. This is where the Faces begin, on October 26, 2021, with a white square head on green, two starburst eyes in boxes and a grid of block teeth. Twenty-seven works hang here, nearly all from the five weeks that followed, and every one of them builds a face out of rectangles. They are the happiest works in the collection, and that is not an accident of color. The box head is a toy, and it knows it.

The box is a frame for parts. Eyes go in as rings, spirals or targets, one in each square. The mouth is a second box with teeth set in it like a grille. A nose is a triangle or a bar. Around the parts the box is filled with scribble, hatching or stripes until it is solid, and then the whole thing is set on a flat color. This is a kit, and the pleasure of the room is watching the artist find out how many faces one kit can make. The spirals in the eyes are the tell: a spiral eye is dizzy, not angry, and the grille of teeth under it is a grin.

Watch the boxes tilt. The first heads sit square. By December they lean, stack and turn, and by the following spring the box has become a tall stack with a mouth of giant bars. One head near the end has shadow in its cheeks and spirals in its eyes, and for a moment the toy looks back at you like a person. Then the box grows ears, and it is a toy again.

chapters.title: The First Box
chapters.opening: Four works from the first five weeks, October 26 to November 27, 2021. The box head arrives, loosens, and tilts, and from the first day the mouth is a grin.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #1
works.text: The first work in the series. A white box head on green, two eyes as cyan starbursts in square frames, a nose of two yellow bars, and a mouth drawn as a grid of white block teeth. A red zigzag runs along the top like a hairline, and green, yellow and brown lines loop around the whole head. Seventy-seven strokes. Everything the room does is already here: the box, the parts in boxes, the grid of teeth. And the face is pleased with itself, which is where the whole collection starts.
works.caption: A white box head on green with cyan starburst eyes in square frames and a grid of white block teeth.
works.reading: The teeth are drawn as rows of white rectangles in a black box, six across and three deep, with white scribble over them. The eyes are cyan rays around a dark center, each in a white and yellow square. The outer lines are drawn in loops that never quite close.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #3
works.text: A head in red, green and black scribble with a mane of red marks, one box eye ringed in white, and a wide red mouth at the lower right, open on white teeth, laughing at something off the page.
works.caption: A head in red, green and black scribble with a mane of red marks and one boxed eye.
works.reading: The box is still there, but only around the eye, a white square with a black ring inside it. The rest of the head is loose scribble in purple, green and black. The mouth is a red oval with white teeth drawn as a row of small bars.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #6
works.text: An angular head in red, blue and yellow line on lavender, with an X in one box eye and bars in the other, a triangle mouth with green zigzag teeth, and a crown of spikes: the first X eye in the collection, and it is a wink.
works.caption: An angular head in red, blue and yellow line on lavender, an X in one boxed eye, a triangle mouth.
works.reading: The lines are drawn in bands of three or four colors side by side, so every edge is a ribbon. The X in the left eye is red over a blue box. The triangle mouth points down with green zigzag inside.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #10
works.text: A head tipped on its side inside a yellow frame, drawn as a dense weave of white, green, orange and magenta lines, with two round eyes and a wide mouth at the bottom, like a picture that fell off the wall and kept smiling.
works.caption: A head tipped on its side inside a yellow frame, drawn as a dense weave of colored lines.
works.reading: The weave is so dense that the face is found slowly: two ringed eyes near the top, a wide mouth of white blocks at the bottom edge. The yellow frame is a soft border with a paler square inside.

chapters.title: Two Days in Winter
chapters.opening: November 30 and December 1, 2021, eight heads in two days. The parts settle: ringed eyes, triangle noses, boxed teeth. This is the kit being learned, fast, and the faces are delighted with themselves.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #12
works.text: Two square eyes side by side, each a red and white target in a box, a red zigzag at the right like a cheek, and below them a long box of white triangle teeth. Cyan hatching runs across the eyes in diagonals. The ground is white with black and green marks at the edges. It is the clearest stack of boxes in the room: eye, eye, mouth, nothing else. The record adds a detail the picture does not show: this one was drawn from a second nnxyz address and sent to the first the same day, and it is still the purest statement of the kit.
works.caption: Two square target eyes side by side in boxes, below them a long box of white triangle teeth.
works.reading: The targets are drawn as red, white and blue rings with a white dot at the center, and the boxes around them are yellow and white. The teeth are white triangles pointing down over a row pointing up, in a box with a red edge.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #13
works.text: A yellow box head on red with a row of white spikes along the top for hair, two ringed eyes with black pupils, a triangle nose, and a box of white teeth under it. Two white hands reach up at the sides, and two small feet stand at the bottom edge. Green, pink and blue hatching fills the box. Nothing else in the room took as many strokes: 801. The hands are up and the feet are planted, and the face in the middle is simply glad to be here. It is the room's self-portrait as a toy.
works.caption: A yellow box head on red with spiky white hair, ringed eyes, a triangle nose, a box of white teeth.
works.reading: The hair is a row of white zigzag along the top edge with pink and black beneath. The eyes are white rings with black pupils in square frames. The hands are drawn in white with black outlines, one at each side of the head. A row of white triangles runs along the lower box like a second set of teeth.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #14
works.text: A box head of purple scribble on yellow, two square eyes with black pupils, a triangle nose, and a white slot of a mouth stitched with black lines, a face holding very still.
works.caption: A box head of purple scribble on yellow, two square eyes with black pupils, a white stitched mouth.
works.reading: The scribble inside the box is purple, blue and red in tight loops with black line over it. The eyes are two white squares with black pupils and a black frame. The mouth is a white rectangle with a few black stitches.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #16
works.caption: A head of angular shards in red, green and cyan hatching on yellow, small box eyes, an open mouth.
works.reading: The head is broken into triangles, each hatched in a different direction. The eyes are two small yellow boxes with black marks. The mouth is a small open oval with teeth.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #17
works.text: A box head in profile on teal, wearing a top hat, with a grin of white teeth, drawn in yellow, green and red hatching: the kit dressed up for an evening out.
works.caption: A box head in profile on teal wearing a top hat, grinning with white teeth, in yellow and green hatching.
works.reading: The hat is a box on top of a box, with a brim drawn in black line. The eye is a white triangle with a red center. The teeth are white blocks in a red box at the lower left.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #18
works.text: A box head on brown with a spiral eye and a box eye, yellow ring earrings at both sides, and a row of white block teeth in a red box, the first dark ground in the room and the grin undimmed.
works.caption: A box head on brown with a spiral eye and a box eye, yellow ring earrings, white teeth in red.
works.reading: The earrings are two yellow loops hanging from the sides of the head. The left eye is a yellow spiral in a white ring; the right is a white box with scribble inside. The teeth are white blocks with black between.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #19
works.text: A box head on maroon with slanted brows and spiral eyes, a red mouth of white fangs, drawn in cyan, white and yellow over dense scribble, the one head in these two days that is trying to look fierce and cannot quite manage it.
works.caption: A box head on maroon with slanted brows, spiral eyes and a red mouth of white fangs.
works.reading: The brows are two thick cyan bars that slope down toward the nose. The eyes are spirals in white rings in boxes. The mouth is a wide red oval with two rows of white fangs.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #21
works.text: A crowned box head in profile on white, facing right, drawn in red, yellow and black line, with a grin of white teeth, a king of nothing in particular.
works.caption: A crowned box head in profile on white, facing right, in red, yellow and black line, grinning.
works.reading: The crown is a row of red and yellow zigzag along the top. The head is a box turned to the right with a square eye and a long nose. The teeth are white blocks in a red box.

chapters.title: Boxes That Tilt and Stack
chapters.opening: December 1 to 6, 2021. Nine heads. The box leans, the jaw becomes a drawer, and the stack gets taller. The grounds go dark for the first time, and the grins get wider to match.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #23
works.caption: A tilted cube of a head on brown, filled with multicolor scribble, a mouth of teeth at the lower left.
works.reading: The cube is drawn in white, cyan and orange line with the corner toward you. Inside, the scribble is every color. The teeth are a row of white blocks in a red box at the lower left.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #24
works.text: A box head on navy drawn in cyan and yellow line, two pink spiral eyes, and a mouth of white blocks in a red box, dizzy and content.
works.caption: A box head on navy in cyan and yellow line, two pink spiral eyes, white blocks for a mouth.
works.reading: The spirals are pink and red, drawn many times over. The box of the head is drawn in cyan and yellow loops. The mouth is a wide red box with white blocks.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #27
works.text: A head on dark brown with two ringed eyes under a pointed brow, and below them a jaw drawn as a drawer: a long box of white triangle teeth, then a second box, then a third, stacked down to the bottom edge. The whole head is filled with green, orange and pink scribble. The jaw here is a stack of its own, the first in the room. The teeth are triangles, which should be a threat, and the stacked drawers under them turn the threat into a chest of toys. This is how the room disarms its own monsters.
works.caption: A head on dark brown with two ringed eyes and a jaw drawn as a stack of three boxes.
works.reading: The eyes are two white rings with black centers under a brow drawn as a V. The teeth are white triangles in the top box, and the lower boxes are filled with scribble. The outline is white and black.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #29
works.text: A head with spiral eyes, spiral cheeks and a white zigzag crown, a V nose and a mouth of white zigzag, drawn in pink, orange and green line on dark brown, every part of it spinning.
works.caption: A head with spiral eyes and spiral cheeks, a white zigzag crown, a V nose, a mouth of white zigzag.
works.reading: The two big spirals are the eyes, drawn in orange, cyan and white. Smaller spirals sit at the cheeks and the chin. The crown is a white zigzag along the top edge with pink below.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #31
works.text: A tall box head on black, two green ring eyes under a pink brow, and an open box of a mouth, drawn in pink, magenta and white scribble, the mouth open as if to say something it has not decided on.
works.caption: A tall box head on black with two green ring eyes and an open white box of a mouth.
works.reading: The head is taller than it is wide, drawn in pink and magenta hatching with a white edge. The mouth is a white rectangle with grey scribble inside. The eyes are green rings with black pupils.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #32
works.text: A box head on olive with two pink spiral eyes, a long nose, and a wide white mouth with yellow zigzag inside, drawn in green and blue facets, cut like a gem.
works.caption: A box head on olive with pink spiral eyes, a long nose and a wide white mouth of yellow zigzag.
works.reading: The head is drawn as facets, each hatched in a different color. The spiral eyes are pink and red in white rings. The mouth is a wide white shape at the bottom with yellow zigzag teeth.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #35
works.text: A head drawn like a sign: stacked rectangles outlined in yellow, spiral eyes in boxes, and a box of black zigzag teeth, on dark olive, a face that could hang over a shop door.
works.caption: A head drawn like a sign, stacked rectangles outlined in yellow, spiral eyes in boxes, black zigzag teeth.
works.reading: The rectangles are stacked three high with thick yellow and white outlines. The eyes are two spirals in boxes, one pink and one blue. The teeth are a black zigzag in a red box.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #43
works.text: A head on blue flattened into bands, drawn in yellow, orange and white line: a band of slit eyes with teeth above them, a band of nose, a wide band of lips, and a chin. The box has become a stack of stripes. Set beside the first head in the room, the parts are the same, eyes, nose, teeth, but every one has been pressed flat and widened. The slit eyes are the first in the room that are not open wide, and the face is the first that is tired. It is the only head here that looks like it has had a long day.
works.caption: A head on blue flattened into bands of slit eyes, nose, wide lips and chin, in yellow and white line.
works.reading: The eyes are two narrow slits with small teeth drawn above them like lashes. The lips are a wide band of red and orange with white line over it. The bands are drawn in tight parallel strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #45
works.text: A patterned head on red with two spiral eyes, two rows of gappy white teeth, and yellow and green bars at the sides, grinning through the gaps.
works.caption: A patterned head on red with two spiral eyes and two rows of gappy white teeth.
works.reading: The teeth are white rounded blocks with red between them, in two rows that do not line up. The spirals are red in white rings. The bars at the sides are drawn in yellow and green like fingers.

chapters.title: The Tall Stacks
chapters.opening: January to March 2022. Six heads, spaced weeks apart, in which the box becomes a tall stack and the teeth grow huge. One of them stops being a toy.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #53
works.text: A head of stacked patterned planes, one eye a box with a slot and the other a triangle, a band of huge white teeth across the bottom, in blue, red and yellow: the teeth have grown to fill the whole lower face.
works.caption: A head of stacked patterned planes, one boxed eye and one triangle eye, huge white teeth across the bottom.
works.reading: The teeth are a row of white rounded blocks as tall as the eyes, with a second row below. The triangle eye at the right is red and white with a slot inside. Yellow bars stand at both sides.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #54
works.caption: A rectangle face on teal with green target eyes and a mouth of zigzag, in pink, orange and green line.
works.reading: The face is a loose rectangle drawn in pink and orange with green targets for eyes. The mouth is a box of zigzag at the bottom. Forty-three strokes, the fewest in the room.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #55
works.text: A blocky head on plum, painted in gold and yellow with white scribble over it, two red spiral eyes staring out, and a mouth of clenched white teeth in a dark box. The head has weight: the brow and the cheeks are modelled in light and shadow, and the eyes sit in deep sockets. It is the one head in the room with shadow, and the spirals in its eyes are the room's spirals, drawn into a face that looks back. For one work the toy becomes a person, and the person is afraid. The clenched teeth are the room's grin with the fun gone out of it. Then the series moves on, and the box goes back to being a box.
works.caption: A blocky head on plum painted in gold, two red spiral eyes staring out, clenched white teeth.
works.reading: The modelling is done in gold, brown and lilac with white loops over it. The eyes are red spirals in white sockets with black rims. The teeth are white bars in a dark box, upper and lower.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #75
works.text: A tall stack of a head on teal, two round white eyes at the top, a mouth of giant white bars in a brown box, drawn in black, brown and blue, a face that is mostly mouth, bellowing or beaming, and from here it is impossible to say which.
works.caption: A tall stacked head on teal, two round white eyes high up, giant white bars for a mouth.
works.reading: The bars of the mouth are as tall as half the head, white with black between them in a brown box. The eyes are two white circles with black pupils and a yellow mark. A white hook at the right is an ear.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #79
works.text: A head on blue with one huge black eye in a white ring, four red capsules for a nose, a grid of white teeth in a red box, and a yellow wavy edge down the right, the eye so large the face is all attention.
works.caption: A head on blue with one huge black eye in a white ring, red capsules for a nose, white teeth.
works.reading: The eye is a black circle with a white highlight, in a white ring in a yellow box. The capsules are four red ovals in a row. The teeth are white blocks in a red box. The yellow edge is drawn in scallops.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #117
works.text: A box head with cat ears on teal, hatched in orange, black and yellow, with crossed eyes in boxes, a long nose, and a grin of white teeth in a red mouth. The last work in the room, from March 29, 2022, four months after the yellow box head with the spiky hair. The parts are the same: boxed eyes, a triangle nose, teeth in a box. The box has grown ears. After the stacks and the one frightened head, the room ends on a joke, and the joke is the kit itself: give the box ears and it is a cat, and the cat is grinning.
works.caption: A box head with cat ears on teal, hatched in orange and black, crossed eyes, a grin of white teeth.
works.reading: The ears are two tall triangles hatched in orange with black edges. The eyes are two boxes with red crossing strokes inside. The teeth are white blocks in a red mouth that curves up at the right.

closing: Look again at the first box head, white on green, with its grid of teeth, and then at the cat-eared box from March. One is a box with parts in it. The other is a box with parts in it and ears. Five months of drawing, and the idea held, because the idea was a game, and the game was still fun.
